name: @nomad/api
description: The Nomad Poker API: a Cloudflare Worker (sign-in, sessions, ledger) on D1 and R2.

scripts.deploy:staging: node ../../infra/check-migrations.mjs staging && npm run build:staging && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode staging --secrets-file .secrets.staging.json
scripts.deploy:production: node ../../infra/check-migrations.mjs production && npm run build:production && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production --secrets-file .secrets.production.json
